card.usage: Cards and raised panels on the page background.

ink.usage: Body text and headings. A deep navy, never pure black.

muted.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, the footer, the role line.

line.usage: Hairline borders of cards and avatars, dividers.

blue.usage: The main colour: links, buttons, focus rings in light mode.

orange.usage: The second colour: accent bars, arrows, the dots between footer items, list markers, focus rings in dark mode. Never for small text on the light background.

paper.usage: The ground behind pen drawings, so they keep their white paper in dark mode.

mono.usage: Small labels: the role line, fact labels, the footer, back links, code.
